Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Aarav - 9 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Ananya - 11 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
3. Sunita - 42 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The garden - flower beds, a mango tree
2. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line
3. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The garden - Day

[Aarav stands in the garden. Sunita stands near him.]

Sunita: "Let's do something fun today."

[Aarav waters the plants.]

Aarav: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Aarav chases a butterfly in the garden.]

Aarav: "This is amazing!"

Scene 2: The terrace - Day

[Aarav stands on the terrace. Sunita stands near him.]

Sunita: "Let's begin."

[Aarav flies a kite on the terrace.]

Aarav (gently): "Mom, are you okay?"

Scene 3: The park - Day

[Aarav stands in the park. Ananya and Sunita stand near him.]

Sunita: "Let's begin."

[Aarav does push-ups.]

Aarav: "Mom, are you okay?"

[Aarav does yoga on a mat.]

Aarav (happily): "Oh wow!"

[Ananya skips rope.]

Sunita: "I really enjoyed today."
